$meta.declares: SEL-1 SP4 output-tiling offline-profile measurement cache (C3' capability-keyed pattern library, measurement layer)
$meta.note: The [SEL-1] measurement library: the OFFLINE-PROFILE cache the capability-keyed SP4 (tiled-vs-plain) tiling selector consults BEFORE its cold-start [XFER-1] prior. Each row memoizes the byte-exact-gated timing of ONE (declared_instance_hash, kernel, variant) instance. This is EVIDENCE-axis mirror data (core-invariants I4): it NEVER chooses route/compute/dtype and it is NEVER a correctness or cost authority in `lib/` -- a measured timing is a cache FACT (authority order: hardware measurement > this cache > static prior). The compiler holds an in-memory VIEW of this file (plugin/rvv RVVRepackTilingSelection.h lookupTilingMeasurement) and, on a HIT for (declared_instance_hash, kernel), picks the memoized argmin variant with reason=measured; on a MISS it falls to the [XFER-1] capability prior (reason=prior).
$meta.seed_state: SEEDED (T3): the 5 K-quant GEMM leaves from the REAL T8 rvv/VLEN128 board (experiments/active/result-tables/T8_winloss_gap_ledger.csv, the [XFER-1] tiling win/loss rows), keyed on the declared_instance_hash the @rvv fixture kernels expand to (3cd23a4e..., the SAME support::computeDeclaredInstanceHash the exec/schedule attribution sinks compute). q4_0 and the iq4 codebook pair carry NO seed row => the compiler cold-starts them via the [XFER-1] prior (reason=prior). A different (un-profiled) board hashes differently => a MISS => the prior. An offline-profile harness on `ssh rvv` fills a row ONLY after the candidate compiles, runs (micro / llama-bench), and PASSES the byte-exact gate for that instance.

key_semantics.declared_instance_hash: SHA-256 (lowercase hex) of the EXPANDED normalized capability fact set -- the SAME support::computeDeclaredInstanceHash the [D-4](1) exec / schedule attribution sinks compute (one helper, one hash). Portable across symbol renames; profile-vs-explicit-list declarations hash equal. The seed rows carry the @rvv fixture instance's hash (3cd23a4e...).
key_semantics.kernel: the decode_model (the SP4 tiling leaf identity), e.g. "q4_K". NOTE the SELECTION keys on the bottleneck SHAPE (fold_model), NEVER this format name; `kernel` is only the measurement-row identity, not a dispatch key.

$meta.decision_rule: The memoized winner of a (declared_instance_hash, kernel) group is the byte-exact-gated variant that REACHES the <=32-vreg register cliff (register_cliff_reached: spill->0, maxVreg <= v30) AND is decisively faster; else the SIMPLER variant (plain) per 更简单者胜. So a MARGINAL non-cliff wall shave does NOT flip the winner to s6_tiled: q3_K's tiled +8% is a byte-exact overhead-shave that neither reaches the cliff (v31) nor flips its ~5.2x vs-block-dot loss, so the honest measured winner is plain (a weight-bound NULL-lever fallback). This is the [XFER-1] transfer-boundary claim recorded as data: measurement itself says 'do not tile here'.

value_shape.selected: true on the winning variant of its (declared_instance_hash, kernel) group (the memoized argmin the in-memory view returns); false on the runner-up.
value_shape.register_cliff_reached: true iff the S6 stack-panel drove hot-loop live-value spill to 0 and maxVreg <= v30 (the <=32-vreg cliff) for this variant -- the structural decision gate.
value_shape.vs_ggml_blockdot_ratio: measured speedup of this variant vs the REAL-dispatched ggml factory block-dot (>1 = our kernel faster). Board rvv/VLEN128, single core.
value_shape.ab_wall_ratio_tiled_over_untiled: the paired-cold A/B wall-time ratio s6_tiled/plain (>1 = s6_tiled faster). Recorded on the group, mirrored on both rows.

board_identity.vreg_count: architectural vector register count (32 for rvv1.0).
board_identity.march: the -march the measurement was taken under (rv64gcv).

value_shape.byte_exact_gate: "pass" -- a row is written ONLY past the byte-exact gate (fail-closed: an un-gated timing is never cached; both variants are bit-identical vs the construction oracle).
value_shape.source: the T8 ledger row + originating commit the measurement is transcribed from.
value_shape.ts: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the measurement (sentinel "0" for the transcribed seed rows).

$meta.fail_closed_revalidate: The selector discards a cached winner that is no longer feasible under the current capability facts (Stage-1 legality re-check) and falls back to the prior -- a stale cache never forces an infeasible variant.
